<kinetic/>Kinetic Weapon Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to <pve 252 /> <pvp [100] /> elemental damage matching your equipped Super in a 4 meter radius. Precision Kills increase the radius to 8 meters.

Elemental Kills grant one stack of 'Crystalline Transitor' for 11 seconds. Maximum of 2 stacks. Stacks expire one at a time.

Crystalline Transitor increases the radius of the explosion to 6|8 Meters, at 1|2 stacks.

Enemies hit by the explosion receive an elemental debuff corresponding to your equipped Super:
• <arc/>Arc: Blinds for <pve ? /> <pvp [1] /> seconds
• <solar/>Solar: Applies 15 Scorch (20 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes)
• <stasis/>Stasis: Applies 30 Slow Stacks for 7 seconds (8 with <stasis/>Whisper of Durance)
• <strand/>Strand: Severs for 6 seconds (8 with <strand/>Thread of Continuity)
• <void/>Void: Weakens for 4 seconds
